messages.subject: Project Vertex - Patent Licence Agreement (draft v1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel, David,

Please find our first draft of the Patent Licence Agreement. It follows the agreed Heads of Terms - exclusive licence in the oncology Field, upfront fee, milestones capped at £54m in aggregate, and the tiered royalty. The Deed of Assignment for the two improvement families will follow separately.

We've left the upfront figure at £6m pending your point on value; happy to discuss. Look forward to your mark-up.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
